name: MiDAS Foods International - USA
old_description: Midas Food International’s award-winning dry blends and food development expertise have revolutionized commercial kitchens for over 40 years. Discover why we’re a trusted partner of food manufacturers and restaurant chains nationwide.
about:
MiDAS Foods International operates from its main campus in Oak Park, Michigan, with a second facility in Birmingham, Alabama. The company has been developing dry blends for commercial kitchens for over 40 years. Leadership includes partners Richard Elias, serving as president, and Gary Freeman, executive vice president of corporate development.

The company manufactures custom dry blends for sauces, seasonings, glazes, gravies, soups, batters, and dessert mixes. Its combined R&D and manufacturing footprint exceeds 150,000 square feet across the two U.S. sites, supplemented by an affiliate plant in Kashipur, India, that ships to more than 20 countries. The culinary team, led by executive chefs Jerry McDonald and Casey Schallert, handles formula development, clean-label systems, and plant-based ingredient platforms.

MiDAS supplies casual dining restaurant chains and food processors nationwide. Restaurant customers use the blends to replace scratch-made sauces and reduce prep time, while manufacturers incorporate them as single-ingredient solutions to cut SKU count, storage costs, and shipping weight. Regional product lines cover North/Midwest flavors such as Michigan baked bean seasoning and beer cheese fondue, and South/Southeast items like Alabama white barbecue sauce and Nashville hot sauce mix.

The company emphasizes that its dry blends lower total cost by minimizing shipping, eliminating refrigeration, and cutting waste. It also promotes custom formulation capabilities that match or exceed scratch culinary standards while improving batch consistency and production throughput.
